market.title: Next James Bond Actor
resolutionNote: Resolves Yes for whichever actor is officially cast as the next James Bond before January 1, 2030 - unauthorized productions and spin-offs don't count.
Kalshi's own wording: "If [Actor] is cast as the next James Bond before Jan 1, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes."

This page is Kalshi-only - Polymarket's equivalent market has a different structure (a fixed resolution date plus a standalone "No Bond chosen" outcome), so the two aren't directly comparable the way our usual Kalshi-vs-Polymarket pages are.

text: The race to become the next James Bond has been one of the most volatile in prediction market history, with the frontrunner changing hands several times throughout 2026.
Jack Lowden has surged into the lead after podcast host Richard Osman claimed on The Rest Is Entertainment that the Scottish actor would "definitely" land the role.
Callum Turner led for much of the year but has since slipped to second, following reports in June of a setback to his chances.
Aaron Taylor-Johnson has also spent time as the frontrunner, with speculation - unconfirmed - that he may already have been offered the role.
No actor has been officially cast, and neither Amazon MGM nor Eon Productions have confirmed a timeline, though filming is speculated to begin in 2027.
